name: AK-47 Scalper EA
summary: The AK-47 Scalper EA is an automated scalping system for MT5 that opens and closes trades rapidly within short timeframes, targeting small pip gains per trade. It uses technical indicators to identify short-term momentum shifts and executes high-frequency entries/exits. The EA is named for its rapid-fire trading style reminiscent of the AK-47's high rate of fire.
summary_zh: AK-47 Scalper EA是一个MT5自动剥头皮交易系统，在短周期内快速开平仓，每笔交易追求小额点差利润。它利用技术指标识别短期动量变化，执行高频交易操作。该EA以其类似AK-47高射速的快速交易风格命名。
strategy_analysis: 该EA采用剥头皮策略概念，在M1或M5等短周期图表上运行，利用技术指标信号快速进出市场。入场条件通常基于短期动量指标的超买超卖信号或快速移动平均线交叉，在价格出现微小波动时立即进场。出场条件依赖较小的止盈目标和相对较紧的止损，以高胜率小额利润累积收益。仓位管理通常采用固定手数或基于账户余额的百分比计算，部分版本可能包含马丁格尔加仓机制。资金管理方面，由于剥头皮交易频率高，点差成本是主要考量因素，但该EA可能缺乏充分的点差过滤保护，存在连续亏损时风险放大的隐患。
strategy_analysis_en: This EA employs a scalping strategy concept, operating on short timeframe charts such as M1 or M5, using technical indicator signals for rapid market entry and exit. Entry conditions are typically based on short-term momentum indicator overbought/oversold signals or fast moving average crossovers, entering positions immediately upon detecting minor price fluctuations. Exit conditions rely on relatively small take-profit targets and tighter stop-losses, accumulating gains through high win-rate small-profit trades. Position sizing typically uses fixed lots or percentage-based calculations derived from account balance, and some versions may incorporate Martingale position-scaling mechanisms. In terms of money management, since scalping involves high trade frequency, spread cost is the primary consideration, but this EA may lack adequate spread filter protection, posing a risk of amplified losses during consecutive losing streaks.

parameters.description: EA魔术编号用于识别订单
parameters.description_en: EA magic number for identifying orders

pros: 快速进出市场，能在波动行情中捕捉短期利润机会
高交易频率配合小止盈目标，单笔风险可控
自动化执行消除了手动剥头皮的情绪干扰和反应延迟
系统化策略有明确的入场和出场规则，交易纪律性强
pros_en: Rapid market entry and exit capability, capturing short-term profit opportunities in volatile markets
High trade frequency combined with small take-profit targets keeps per-trade risk manageable
Automated execution eliminates emotional interference and reaction delays inherent in manual scalping
Systematic strategy with clearly defined entry and exit rules enforces strong trading discipline
cons: 高频交易产生大量点差成本，在点差扩大时可能全部利润被吞噬
剥头皮策略对经纪商执行质量极度敏感，滑点和重新报价可能导致显著亏损
缺乏多时间框架确认，容易在趋势反转时连续开仓造成叠加亏损
小止损在市场剧烈波动时可能被频繁触发导致连续亏损
可能存在过度优化风险，历史回测表现难以在实盘中复制
cons_en: High-frequency trading generates substantial spread costs; widening spreads can entirely erode profits
Scalping strategy is extremely sensitive to broker execution quality; slippage and requotes can cause significant losses
Lack of multi-timeframe confirmation leads to consecutive entries during trend reversals causing compounded losses
Tight stop-losses may be frequently triggered during volatile market conditions resulting in consecutive losses
Potential over-optimization risk where historical backtest performance is difficult to replicate in live trading
improvements: 增加多时间框架趋势过滤器，避免在主趋势方向相反时开仓
添加动态点差过滤和交易时段限制，避免在低流动性高点差时段交易
引入动态止损止盈机制，根据市场波动率(ATR)自适应调整
improvements_en: Add multi-timeframe trend filter to avoid opening positions against the prevailing trend direction
Implement dynamic spread filtering and trading session restrictions to avoid trading during low-liquidity high-spread periods
Introduce dynamic stop-loss and take-profit mechanisms that adapt based on market volatility (ATR)

risk_points: 高频剥头皮在点差扩大时可能造成连续亏损
小止损容易被市场噪音触发，缺乏波动率自适应机制
对经纪商执行质量高度依赖，滑点风险显著
risk_points_en: High-frequency scalping can cause consecutive losses when spreads widen
Tight stop-losses are easily triggered by market noise without volatility-adaptive mechanisms
Heavy dependence on broker execution quality with significant slippage risk
